extraction_notes: Target MPN IRFR024NTRPBF is the tape-and-reel packing option of IRFR024NPbF; the supplied datasheet (International Rectifier PD-95066A, 12/14/04) covers IRFR024NPbF (D-Pak) and IRFU024NPbF (I-Pak). International Rectifier is now part of Infineon Technologies; target identity preserved as briefed.
The PDF has essentially no text layer for tables and figures; all values were read visually from 150 dpi page renders and 300 dpi figure crops of pages 1-4.
Curve points were digitized manually from Fig 1 (output), Fig 3 (transfer), and Fig 5 (capacitance) axis grids; estimated digitization uncertainty is about 5-10% on log axes.

Capacitance curve points at V_DS = 25 V were cross-checked against the page 2 table values (C_iss 370 pF, C_oss 140 pF, C_rss 65 pF) and agree; all capacitances are reported in farads per SI-unit requirement.
In Fig 1 the ohmic-region traces for V_GS >= 8 V overlap; the V_GS = 10 V curve ohmic points are read from the merged bundle and are consistent with R_DS(on) approximately 0.075 ohm.
Table specs on page 2 list only min/max for V_GS(th) (2.0 V / 4.0 V) and only a max for R_DS(on) (0.075 ohm at V_GS = 10 V, I_D = 10 A); no typical values are published for these.
Additional table facts not schema-mapped: I_D 17 A at T_C = 25 C, Q_g 20 nC max (I_D = 10 A, V_DS = 44 V, V_GS = 10 V), g_fs 4.5 S min, t_rr 56 ns typ / 83 ns max, R_thJC 3.3 C/W max.
No vendor SPICE or model-pack data was used; every value comes from the public datasheet PDF.
